findings.detail: Two authorities for cold setup conflict: M1.19's budget step in pnpm verify fails whenever .harness/budget.json predates pnpm-lock.yaml, while M2.21's CI cold-setup job measures cold setup live every run (check-budget --cold) but writes nothing. ci.yml's verify matrix runs pnpm verify on all three OSes, so after any lockfile change verify is red everywhere until someone re-records on a machine that can download Chromium; the CI job's own measurement cannot clear it. The M2 verify and CI-evidence legs have no agent-runnable path to green.
findings.failure_scenario: A human re-records and M2 closes; the next lockfile PR turns ci verify red on three OSes although the same run's cold-setup job measured the setup under budget.

findings.area: standards drift (verify skill rule 2, drive stop conditions)
findings.detail: pnpm verify has been red at the budget step since M2.6 (first lockfile change); blockedReason and progress.md mention it only from M2.21/M2.22. The staged ladder does not run the budget step.
findings.failure_scenario: A later milestone breaks a verify-only step and ships many commits on a red full ladder.

findings.detail: geometry exports its own Result<T>/GeometryError/err(code, message) while schema exports Result<T, E = FluxError>/err(error); no ADR records the deviation.
findings.failure_scenario: M3 core imports both: Result collides, err has two signatures, geometry codes are missing from FluxErrorCode.

findings.area: spec fidelity / docs (M2.23, M2 cp1 F5)
findings.detail: docs-consistency checks documented→schema only, and element-row fields against the union of core kinds.
findings.failure_scenario: A required field added to a record schema never reaches the catalogue; the test still passes.

findings.detail: check-ci-evidence exits on the first REST transport failure, hiding the stale-evidence floor error collected before it.
findings.failure_scenario: An operator chases auth/proxy instead of pushing and re-recording.

findings.detail: fast-check is a runtime dependency of the published @fluxion/schema only for the ./testing entry.
findings.failure_scenario: The first npm release ships a property-testing library to every end user.

findings.detail: 'fixtures/docs behave as named' treats non-invalid fixtures as merely valid; unknown-kind is never checked for FLX_KIND_UNKNOWN.
findings.failure_scenario: A builder refactor drops the unknown kind from the shared fixture unnoticed.
